# Dental Care of Mid Florida

> A comprehensive dental practice in Sebring, FL offering general, cosmetic, restorative, and specialized treatments including TMJ therapy, Invisalign, and aesthetic procedures under Dr. Ernesto Llerena.

Dental Care of Mid Florida is a full-service dental practice located in Sebring, Florida, led by Dr. Ernesto Llerena, a bilingual dentist. The practice provides a wide range of services from preventive care and general dentistry to advanced cosmetic and restorative treatments, including specialized procedures like TMJ syndrome treatment and endodontic surgery.
